# How god works

Everything so far has been the grammar. This part is the machinery underneath
it, and it matters because it is what you reach for at the edges.

Nothing runs until you ask for it. Any pipeline will print itself back to you in
a language you already use, which is the way out when the vocabulary does not
cover what you need. A table that lives in a warehouse can be read where it
sits. And when something is wrong, the whole pipeline is checked before any of
it runs.

Read this part if you are deciding whether to depend on god. It is where the
claims made in the preface are demonstrated rather than asserted.
